skills.name: Ambient and cinematic arrangement: staggered layers, arcs, underscore and hybrid score roles
skills.goal: Arrange ambient and cinematic cues: role-first layering (drone, string swells, motor ostinato), staggered entries, frequency-range layering, emotional arc (subtle intro -> climax -> fade), dialogue-safe underscore, multi-section arcs and minimal one-note horror cues.

skills.name: Arrangement: loop to full song in 8-bar blocks (intro, build, drop, breakdown, outro)
skills.goal: Turn a loop into a finished electronic/pop arrangement: start from the full loop (the climax), subtract to make sections, change something every 8 bars, build-ups with risers and snare rolls, pre-drop low-end removal, breakdowns, withheld reveals and rule-of-three phrasing.

skills.name: Bass design: sub, Reese, 808, punchy bass and distortion layering
skills.goal: Design basses that translate: clean sine sub split from a distorted mid layer, Reese detuned saws, punchy 808 with pitch envelope, archetype punchy basses, sub drops and cinematic distortion stacks; keep kick/bass relationship clear.

skills.name: Binaural and isochronic tone layers under music (audio construction only)
skills.goal: Build binaural (L/R frequency difference) and isochronic (gated carrier) layers under music: carrier pitch in key, beat/pulse rate, raised-cosine gating, pad foundation, notching the bed at the carrier, fades. No health claims.

skills.name: Brightness and air at the source for pads and textures
skills.goal: Make pads bright and airy from the start (instead of boosting treble at the end): choose harmonically rich oscillators, open and key-track the filter, add octave/fifth layers, excite upper harmonics, add a quiet air-noise layer, brighten before reverb and only then a gentle shelf.

skills.name: distill transcript
skills.goal: Turn raw caption text into actionable procedure lines.

skills.name: Drum groove programming: genre patterns, swing, ghost notes and sparse ambient beats
skills.goal: Program grooves that feel right: four-on-floor, half-time future garage, sparse ambient kits with accent maps, ghost snares, swing amount, and phrase variation every 2/4/8 bars.

skills.name: Drum synthesis and hybrid percussion (kick, snare, clap, hats, taiko, epic hits)
skills.goal: Synthesize a complete kit and cinematic percussion from oscillators and noise: kick pitch envelope, snare body + noise, 3-burst clap, hats, toms/taiko from noise with resonant filters, layered epic hybrid hits, ensemble multiplication, resampled velocity layers, and drive to cut through.

skills.name: Filter design: types, resonance, key-tracking, filter banks and envelopes
skills.goal: Choose and drive filters musically: LP/BP/HP/notch morphing, ladder/diode/comb flavours, resonance, key-tracking, velocity and envelope amount, parallel/serial and multi-band filter banks, talking/formant filtering and sample-rate reduction.

skills.name: FM, phase modulation, phase distortion, sync, ring mod and wavefolding
skills.goal: Create bells, keys, metallic and aggressive timbres with carrier:modulator ratios and index, operator stacks, phase distortion (Casio-style), hard/windowed sync, ring/amplitude modulation, cross-modulation and wavefolding.

skills.name: Generative ambient: drones, wind, sparkle layers and self-playing soundscapes
skills.goal: Build self-playing ambient pieces: noise beds and generative wind, tonic drones and PW drones, Eno-style sine pads, probability-gated seeded loops, follow-action clip pools, random-modulated loop voices, high-end sparkle layers and three-layer starters.

skills.name: Generative rhythm: Euclidean patterns, polyrhythm, polymeter, probability and endless tempo illusions
skills.goal: Generate rhythms and melodies algorithmically: Euclidean E(k,n) with rotation and boolean combinations, multi-layer scale weavers, polymeter lengths, probability/chance gates with seeds, constrained random sequencers, Risset accelerando and pendulum-wave phasing.

skills.name: Granular and spectral texture design (freeze, clouds, blur, stretch)
skills.goal: Turn short sources into sustained, evolving textures with grain size, density, position, spray and freeze, live granular buffers, spectral blur/freeze/warp and extreme time-stretch.

skills.name: Harmony: chord qualities, voicing, voice leading and slow ambient harmonic motion
skills.goal: Write chord progressions and voicings: diatonic chords in a key, extended/sus chords, spread voicings with one chord tone per instrument, voice leading (hold common tones, move by step), pedal points and slow one-key harmonic motion.

skills.name: Check a transcript graph against the skill library, merge it into the knowledge graph, outline skills only for gaps
skills.goal: Compare a video's term graph with the published skill catalog and public prior-art, mark which terms and relations are new, merge everything into a persistent knowledge graph (knowledge/graph.json, references only), and draft skill outlines only where a contiguous run of grounded procedure steps covers 2+ gap items. Each outline gets nearest-skill and novelty verdicts, then goes through distill-transcript -> quality_check -> novelty_check. Delta vs generic dedupe or novelty checks: coverage is judged at the level of params, values, and modulation relations (not just title similarity), and outlines carry timestamped evidence spans instead of free-written steps.

skills.name: Mixdown workflow: gain staging, subtractive EQ, dynamic EQ, multiband and saturation
skills.goal: Mix a track to a reference: gain stage to sensible levels, balance with faders first, subtractive EQ (high-pass non-bass, cut mud 200-400 Hz), the three-questions dynamic EQ approach, mid/side EQ, gentle multiband low control, selective saturation and parallel processing.

skills.name: Modulation: LFOs, envelopes, sample & hold, random and nested routing
skills.goal: Animate sounds with a mod matrix: LFO rate/sync/shape, envelopes and curves, sample & hold, smooth random, envelope followers, per-voice random offsets, nested modulation (mod of mod depth) and random/probability gates.

skills.name: Phaser, flanger and comb movement on pads
skills.goal: Add sweeping notch movement to pads with phasers (all-pass notches), flangers/combs (harmonic notches) and chorus/ensemble, including the high-pass phaser chord pad and the dual slow stereo phaser dreamy pad.

skills.name: Supersaw / unison pads: detune, voice count, width and filter swell
skills.goal: Build a wide, warm detuned-saw pad (house, trance, cinematic) by choosing voice count and detune in cents, spreading voices in stereo, then shaping with a key-tracked low-pass, slow attack/release and space FX.

skills.name: Physical modelling: Karplus-Strong plucks, bowed/struck strings, modal and comb resonators
skills.goal: Synthesize plucked, bowed, struck and resonant instruments by exciting delay lines, comb filters and modal resonator banks with noise or clicks, controlling damping, brightness and body.

skills.name: Reverb, delay, shimmer and freeze: creating depth and space
skills.goal: Place sounds in space with sends: choose reverb type, pre-delay and low-cut, tempo-synced and ping-pong delays, distorted/band-limited delay throws, shimmer (+12 pitch in feedback), reverb freeze/reverse swells and fully-wet extreme reverb pads.

skills.name: Transition FX: risers, downlifters, whooshes, impacts, braams and Shepard tones
skills.goal: Design transition sounds: noise risers with BP/HP sweeps, pitch-ramp and FM uplifters, downlifters, doppler whooshes, synthesized impacts with tails, braams, Shepard endless risers and one-bar mod-envelope transitions.

skills.name: Scales, modes and melody writing (mode colour, motifs, phrasing)
skills.goal: Choose a scale/mode for the mood (Lydian bright -> Phrygian dark), use the characteristic note, and write motifs with call-and-response and rule-of-three phrasing.

skills.name: Sidechain and ducking per element (kick/bass, pads, trance gate, pump)
skills.goal: Apply sidechain correctly per element: bass/lows duck fully for the whole kick, leads/pads duck only on the punch, depth follows loudness, multiband sidechain for full-range sounds, plus trance-gate chops and pumping pads.

skills.name: Stereo width: Haas, mid/side, detune, short-IR and mono-safe widening
skills.goal: Widen sounds without phase problems: asymmetric L/R processing, Haas delays with phase offsets, short-IR wideners, band-split widening (highs wide, lows mono), chord-split panning and stereo filter/ladder spread.

skills.name: Synth strings, ensemble and choir layers
skills.goal: Build string-section and choir-like synth layers: PWM 80s strings, unison with delayed vibrato, saw/FM blends, opposite-direction arpeggiated plucks that read as strings, noise-comb ensemble pads and hybrid choir pads.

skills.name: Extract a term/relation graph from a how-to transcript with domain lexicons
skills.goal: Parse an English how-to transcript into a JSON graph of useful data. Nodes are concepts, modules, params, values, tools, procedure steps, and repeated phrases. Edges are sets (param -> value), affects (mod source -> target), precedes (step order), part-of (param -> module, module -> tool), and mentions (step -> term), each with timestamped evidence quotes. Matching uses domain lexicons for synth/sound design, Blender, crypto tooling, side hustle, and drone/splat capture, plus bigram/trigram collocation mining for terms the lexicon doesn't know. Delta vs generic keyword or knowledge-graph skills (understand-anything): deterministic and stdlib-only, unit-aware value attachment (dB -> slope/level, semitones -> pitch, voices -> unison), and evidence-grounded edges built for gap checking against a skill catalog.

skills.name: Offline machine translation of a non-English transcript with a synth/DAW glossary
skills.goal: Turn an original-language Show-transcript (es, de, ja, fr, pt, it) into an English transcript with a free offline translator (argos-translate), segment by segment with the original timestamps. Fix known domain mistranslations after translating ('envolvente' rendered as 'cover' -> 'envelope'), reject garbled model output, and keep the original words. Delta vs generic translation skills (azure-ai-translation-*, translate-book): offline and free, timestamp-preserving for transcripts, with a post-edit glossary for sound-design vocabulary and a garble detector.

skills.name: Vocoder, formant and spectral voice effects
skills.goal: Use vocoders and formant tools: vocoder as an insert on any patch (carrier/modulator), formant shifting, frequency-shifted harmonic layers, spectral warp/stretch and five-stage hybrid transform chains (pitch, formant, saturation, key-tuned peak, LP push-back).

skills.name: Wavetable, vector and wave-sequence morphing for evolving pads
skills.goal: Create pads and textures whose timbre evolves by modulating wavetable position, crossfading two or four sources (vector/XY), or sequencing waves, instead of relying on a filter.

skills.name: YouTube knowledge pipeline router (self-questioning conditional chain)
skills.goal: Orchestrate the YouTube distillery as an explicit decision tree: the agent asks itself yes/no questions (env OK? transcript saved? video available? rate-limited? any track? which track rung? translation needed or failed? transcript usable? domain matched? gaps found?) and picks the matching skill next: topic search -> track-ladder fetch -> machine translation -> term graph -> gap check / KG merge -> distill + quality + novelty gates. Every question, answer, evidence and branch is logged. Delta vs generic agent routers or skill-chaining packs: the conditions are concrete YouTube transcript barriers (429/IP blocks, AI-dub tracks, tlang throttling, removed videos, disabled transcripts) with a logged branch for each, and ASR is never run automatically.

skills.name: Fetch YouTube Show-transcript text via a language-aware track ladder
skills.goal: Fetch the best English Show-transcript text for a YouTube video by listing every transcript track and walking a fixed ladder: manual English > auto English spoken in the original audio > YouTube-translated track (tlang=en) > English auto track of an AI-dub audio track > original-language track plus offline machine translation. Handle 429/IP blocks, removed videos, and disabled transcripts honestly. Delta vs generic transcript fetchers (youtube-skills, youtube-fetcher): it tells original audio apart from YouTube AI-dub tracks, keeps the original words beside any translation, and logs every decision.

skills.name: YouTube how-to topic search with filters and transcript precheck
skills.goal: Find distillable how-to YouTube videos for a topic across several languages, filter by duration, upload recency, views and how-to title signals, and precheck which ones have a Show transcript (manual, auto, AI-dub, or YouTube-translatable to English) before anything is fetched. Delta vs generic youtube search skills (e.g. VoltAgent youtube-skills, last30days-skill): multilingual how-to keyword expansion, negative-signal filtering, and a per-video transcript-track precheck that feeds the knowledge-pipeline router.
